acceptance: CI logs show the 0.9.2 isolation case executed (not skipped), or the supported-runtime list and the test no longer name 0.9.2.
A skip of a listed runtime in CI is reported as a failure or an explicit warning in the job summary.
description:
Gap. `tests/integration/test_duckdb_version_isolation.py` exercises `DuckDBAdapter.create_connection` against isolated runtimes including 0.9.2. On macOS arm64 on 2026-11-12 the 0.9.2 build failed and the case was skipped for lack of an isolated runtime, so a change to connection setup (the version-gated `lambda_syntax` setting in PR #4175) was verified on 1.0.0, 1.2.2, 1.3.x, 1.5.5 and 2.0.0 but not on the oldest version the test claims to cover. Whether CI on Linux actually runs the 0.9.2 case was not checked.

Expected: either CI demonstrably runs the 0.9.2 case and a skip there fails the job, or 0.9.2 is dropped from the supported runtimes and the test with a recorded reason.

Guardrails: do not make the local developer run fail on a platform where the wheel cannot be built; the requirement is on CI.
